short_description.text: Elkanah — father of Samuel (1SA 1:1, 1SA 1:20). Of the tribe of Levi.
Jeroham — father of Elkanah and grandfather of Samuel (1SA 1:1). Of the tribe of Levi.
Elihu — father of Jeroham and ancestor of Samuel (1SA 1:1). Of the tribe of Levi.
Tohu — father of Elihu and ancestor of Samuel (1SA 1:1). Of the tribe of Levi.
Zuph — father of Tohu and ancestor of Samuel (1SA 1:1). Of the tribe of Levi.
Hannah — wife of Elkanah (1SA 1:2), mother of Samuel (1SA 1:20).
Peninnah — wife of Elkanah (1SA 1:2).
Eli — priest of Israel in Shiloh (1SA 1:3). Of the tribe of Levi.
Hophni — son of Eli (1SA 1:3), a corrupt priest (1SA 2:12). Of the tribe of Levi.
Phinehas — son of Eli (1SA 1:3), a corrupt priest (1SA 2:12). Of the tribe of Levi.
Samuel — son of Elkanah and Hannah (1SA 1:20). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ichabod — Phinehas's son (1SA 4:21), Eli's grandson. Of the tribe of Levi.
Joshua — the Beth-shemite (1SA 6:14).
Abinadab — the ark of the stored was kept in his house in Kiriath-jearim (1SA 7:1).
Eleazar — consecrated to keep the ark in Kiriath-jearim (1SA 7:1).
Joel — firstborn of Samuel (1SA 8:2, 1CH 6:28, 1CH 6:33). Of the tribe of Levi.
Abijah — second son of Samuel (1SA 8:2). Of the tribe of Levi.
Abiel — (grand?)father of Kish (1SA 9:1), (great?) grandfather of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Zeror — father of Abiel (1SA 9:1), ancestor of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Becorath — father of Zeror (1SA 9:1), ancestor of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Aphiah — father of Becorath (1SA 9:1), ancestor of King Saul. Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Saul — son of Kish (1SA 9:2), King of Israel (1SA 11:15). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Nahash — King of the Ammonites (1SA 11:2). Of the tribe of Ammonite.
Jonathan — son of King Saul (1SA 13:16). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Ahijah — priest at Shiloh, nephew of Ichabod (1 SA 14:3), and prophet (1KI 11:29). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ahitub — son of Phinehas, grandson of Eli, and father of Ahijah (1SA 14:3). Of the tribe of Levi.
Ishvi — son of Saul (1SA 14:49). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Malchi-shua — son of Saul (1SA 14:49). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Merab — daughter of Saul (1SA 14:49). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Michal — daughter of Saul (1SA 14:49) and barren (2SA 6:23) wife of King David (1SA 18:27). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Ahinoam — wife of Saul (1SA 14:50).
Ahimaaz — father of Ahinoam (1SA 14:50).
Abner — captain of Saul's army and Saul's uncle (1SA 14:50). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Ner — father of Abner (1SA 14:50). Of the tribe of Benjamin.
Agag — king of the Amalekites (1SA 15:8).
Eliab — firstborn (1CH 2:13) son of Jesse (1SA 16:6) brother of David. Of the tribe of Judah.
Abinadab — second-born (1CH 2:13) son of Jesse (1SA 16:8) brother of David. Of the tribe of Judah.
Shammah — third-born (1CH 2:13) son of Jesse (1SA 16:9) brother of David. Of the tribe of Judah.
Goliath — Philistine champion, from Gath (1SA 17:4).
Adriel — the Meholathite (1SA 18:19).
Ahimelech — the priest of Nob (1SA 21:1). Of the tribe of Levi.
Doeg — the Edomite (1SA 21:7).
Achish — King of Gath (1SA 21:10) before whom David feigned madness.
King of Moab — King of Moab to whom David took his parents (1SA 22:3).
Gad — the prophet (1SA 22:5), the seer (1CH 21:9, 1CH 29:29).
Abiathar — son of Ahimelech, the priest (1SA 22:20), counselor to David (1CH 27:34). Of the tribe of Levi.
Nabal — the rich man of Maon, husband of Abigail (1SA 25:3). Of the tribe of Judah.
Abigail — the Carmelitess (1SA 25:3).
Palti — Michal's new husband (1SA 25:44).
Laish — from Gallim (1SA 25:44).
Ahimelech — the Hittite (1SA 26:6).
Abishai — son of Zeruiah and Joab's brother (1SA 26:6), chief of "the thirty" of David's men (2SA 23:18). Of the tribe of Judah.
Zeruiah — mother of Abishai, Joab (1SA 26:6), and Asahel (2SA 2:18), sister of King David (1CH 2:16). Of the tribe of Judah.
Joab — son of Zeruiah (2SA 2:13), commander of David's army (1CH 27:34). Of the tribe of Judah.
Maoch — father of the king of Gath (1SA 27:2).
